mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing torsemide levels; combined use increases risk of electrolyte depletion and ototoxicity due to loop diuretic effects, particularly with protease inhibitor-associated metabolic effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) and renal function closely; consider alternative diuretic or dose adjustment; counsel on ototoxicity symptoms; maintain adequate hydration.
